rules.logic: GATE XQL(SIM-TIM-004 Cert-Fingerprint Indicator Ingested) — a feed-presence precondition confirming the self-signed certificate fingerprint is armed in threat_intel (it is not a join participant). JOIN BIOC(SIM-TIM-004 Estate Handshake to a TIM-Armed Self-Signed Certificate) with XQL(SIM-TIM-004 Shared Self-Signed Cert Fingerprint Fan-Out Across IPs) on the shared tls_cert_fingerprint_sha1 entity within the correlation window — both carry that key. Together they fuse the certificate-fingerprint IOC match with the multi-IP fingerprint fan-out into one Resource-Development adversary-infrastructure incident scoped to the shared certificate. The incident rolls up every co-fingerprinted IP the estate touched under that one fingerprint.
rules.name: SIM-TIM-004 Certificate-Fingerprint Infrastructure-Cluster Incident
